title: Gate nightly releases on full CI for a pinned commit and reduce daytime CI
description: Keep quick Linux/runtime CI only for PR authors with write, maintain, or admin access; run full v3 platform, template, packaging, and cross-compile checks for third-party PRs and before releases. Pin release checks and publication source to one SHA, fail closed for missing CI, and reject branch movement instead of releasing untested changes.
close_reason: Implemented maintainer-only quick CI and pinned full pre-release validation. Actionlint, 5 CI regression tests, 16 changelog tests, release Go tests passed; CodeRabbit reported no findings.
